schema.claims: CREATE TABLE claims (id BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(id)=32), h_o BLOB CHECK(h_o IS NULL OR length(h_o)=32), status INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(status BETWEEN 0 AND 8), epoch BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(epoch)=8), retracted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(retracted IN (0,1)), vocab BLOB CHECK(vocab IS NULL OR length(vocab)=32), formula BLOB, scope TEXT, checker BLOB CHECK(checker IS NULL OR length(checker)=32)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
schema.deps: CREATE TABLE deps (claim BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(claim)=32), premise BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(premise)=32), PRIMARY KEY(claim,premise)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
schema.citable: CREATE TABLE citable (ref BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(ref)=32), epoch BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(epoch)=8), PRIMARY KEY(ref,epoch)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
schema.revoked: CREATE TABLE revoked (checker BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(checker)=32)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
schema.facts: CREATE TABLE facts (id BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(id)=32), fact BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(fact)=32), issuer BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(issuer)=32), topic TEXT NOT NULL, first BLOB CHECK(first IS NULL OR length(first)=8), last BLOB CHECK(last IS NULL OR length(last)=8), until BLOB CHECK(until IS NULL OR length(until)=8), CHECK((first IS NULL AND last IS NULL AND until IS NOT NULL) OR (first IS NOT NULL AND last IS NOT NULL AND until IS NULL))) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
schema.metadata: CREATE TABLE metadata (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), seq INTEGER, epoch BLOB, hash BLOB, CHECK((seq IS NULL AND epoch IS NULL AND hash IS NULL) OR (seq>=0 AND length(epoch)=8 AND length(hash)=32))) STRICT
schema.facts_fact: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX facts_fact ON facts(fact)
schema.trust: CREATE TABLE trust (issuer BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(issuer)=32), topic TEXT NOT NULL, config BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(config)=32), PRIMARY KEY(issuer,topic)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
schema.trust_configs: CREATE TABLE trust_configs (id BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(id)=32), version BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(version)=8)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
schema.trust_configs_version: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX trust_configs_version ON trust_configs(version)
schema.revoked_issuers: CREATE TABLE revoked_issuers (issuer BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(issuer)=32), since BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(since)=8), event BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(event)=32)) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
